text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's finally, finally, finaaally here!
This glorious daaaay!!

The day of her debut race arrived.
Tamamo Cross was practically bursting with motivation.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm a bit on the small side,
I ain't gonna lose in the Junior Class!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
After all, my fighting spirit is on a whole 'nother level!
I'll beat the living daylights outta every single one of 'em!

Even from a Trainer's perspective, she shouldn't be falling
behind opponents at this level, but...

Looking at the table, there was an empty bento box.
A tiny, tiny bento box that Tamamo Cross had just finished eating from.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What do you mean? It's my bento box.
choice_data_list: Was that little amount really enough?
Was that little amount really enough?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-You really shouldn't be stuffing your face
like that right before the main event."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Eatin' too much makes the blood stop flowin' right.
Just a little bite's plenty.
Tamamo Cross headed off toward the race, looking a little flustered.
